culpritSource.quote: The Detective Boys and Conan solve the case and show the police that they were wrong about almost everything that happened. The culprit is Sakanobu Nekota. It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

motive.quote: Because Nekota was a former Triathlonist, he had no problem in performing the stated stunts.

method.quote: After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving.

evidence.quote: It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

motive.zhHans: 由于 Nekota 出身铁人三项选手，完成那些动作毫无问题。又因为他必须尽快赶去和发现 Atomura 尸体的人会合，他来不及处理掉化装用品、绳索，以及抢劫时放在外套口袋里的那枚胸针。Nekota 不愿被勒索，于是决定让 Atomura 永远闭嘴。但他对杀害 Atomura 也怀着愧疚——从两人创立公司那天起，他们就一起吃苦、并肩工作；于是他决定先把胸针留着，等风波过去，再以「她亡夫生前留下的礼物」之名交给 Atomura 的妻子。
motive.en: Because Nekota was a former Triathlonist, he had no problem in performing the stated stunts. Because he had to join up with those that discover Atomura's body as fast as possible, he is unable to dispose of the disguises, rope, or the broach that he had kept in the coat's pocket during the robbery. Not willing to be blackmailed, Nekota decided to silence Atomura. However, Nekota also feels guity about murdering Atomura, as he had gone through hardship and worked alongside him since the day they founded the company, and decides to keep the broach until the situation die down and gives it to Atomura's wife as the "present from her late husband".

method.zhHans: 在确认尸体落到卡车上之后，他架好逃跑用的绳索，让工人们继续搬东西。接着，他化装去抢劫珠宝店，并把高木引到旧事务所对面那栋楼的楼顶。又因为他必须尽快赶去和发现 Atomura 尸体的人会合，他来不及处理掉化装用品、绳索，以及抢劫时放在外套口袋里的那枚胸针。另一方面，由美又在盘算让另一位警官上她的当。
method.en: After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving. Next, he went to rob the jewelry store in disguise, and lured Takagi to the top of the building across the old office. Because he had to join up with those that discover Atomura's body as fast as possible, he is unable to dispose of the disguises, rope, or the broach that he had kept in the coat's pocket during the robbery. Elsewhere, Yumi is scheming for another officer to fall for her trick again.

evidence.zhHans: 经揭示，他们看到的那个强盗并不是 Atomura，真正的犯人其实是 Nekota。
evidence.en: It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

resolution.zhHans: 少年侦探团与柯南解开案件，向警方证明他们对整起事件的判断几乎全都错了。犯人是 Sakanobu Nekota。经揭示，他们看到的那个强盗并不是 Atomura，真正的犯人其实是 Nekota。首先，Nekota 把搬家工人叫到旧事务所的九楼，把 Atomura 推了下去。在确认尸体落到卡车上之后，他架好逃跑用的绳索，让工人们继续搬东西。
resolution.en: The Detective Boys and Conan solve the case and show the police that they were wrong about almost everything that happened. The culprit is Sakanobu Nekota. It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one. First, Nekota called the moving workers to the 9th floor of his old office and pushed Atomura to his doom. After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving.
